subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp trial plan and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp trial plan and next steps

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for the great discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an evaluation started:

- Success criteria (from our notes): 1) Reduce average latency for 512-token prompts to < 200ms, 2) Maintain answer accuracy on core retrieval prompts (target F1 > 0.85), 3) Cost per 1k tokens below $X.
- Proposed evaluation scope: 2-week trial with a sandbox dataset and a curated prompt set (we'll run both throughput and quality evals).
- Deliverables: trial plan, prompt set, test harness instructions, and a follow-up technical deep dive to scope infra and security.

Can we schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff next week to align on the trial plan and do a technical deep dive? Proposed slots (PT):
  • Wed 11/18 — 10:00–11:00am PT
  • Thu 11/19 — 2:00–3:00pm PT
  • Fri 11/20 — 9:00–10:00am PT

Please pick one that works and confirm attendees — please include Sam (CTO) and anyone from procurement who needs to be looped in. I will attach the draft eval plan and prompt set to this thread so you can review ahead of the call.

Agenda we suggest: intros (5m), trial plan and success criteria (15m), technical deep dive & infra checklist (30m), open Q&A & next steps (10m).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-Eval-Plan-v1.pdf, ACME-eval-prompt-set.csv
